headlessValidation: Validate the portable package, OpenAI overlay, assets, and any declared MCP configuration against pinned schemas and source-reviewed rules.
Run a clean local add, discovery, install, list, update, and removal lifecycle without treating it as connected-host evidence.
humanGates: Review publisher identity, source provenance, requested permissions, and release contents before distribution.
limitations: Local package validation proves neither workspace availability, directory review, ChatGPT behavior, nor Codex behavior.

headlessValidation: Validate the exact package and policy metadata selected for workspace synchronization.
humanGates: Use an authorized workspace admin to synchronize, approve, install, update, and remove the package in a staging workspace.
Record workspace policy, plan, locale, and review state without implying public-directory availability.
limitations: Workspace marketplace evidence proves neither Universal Plugins Directory publication nor ChatGPT or Codex runtime behavior.

headlessValidation: Validate package structure, listing metadata, assets, and the source-controlled submission dossier before upload.
humanGates: Use a verified publisher with Apps Management Write access to upload the exact artifact and retain its current scan and review outcome.
Review privacy, terms, support, permissions, listing copy, and any media required for the product that was actually scanned.
limitations: An approved directory listing does not prove activation or behavior in either ChatGPT or Codex.

headlessValidation: Validate the exact artifact, activation fixtures, expected tool boundaries, and redaction plan before connected-host testing.
humanGates: Connect an authorized ChatGPT staging workspace and record activation, positive, boundary, failure, and removal cases for the exact plan, region, and locale.
limitations: ChatGPT runtime evidence proves neither Codex behavior nor directory publication.

headlessValidation: Run the pinned official Codex add, discovery, install, list, update, and removal lifecycle in a disposable profile.
Record exact Codex version, channel, operating system, architecture, artifact digest, and boundary-case results.
humanGates: Approve any account-bound, OAuth, write-capable, or public-directory test that cannot run in the disposable local profile.
limitations: A local Codex lifecycle proves neither ChatGPT behavior nor workspace or public-directory availability.

headlessValidation: Lint exported instructions, OpenAPI definitions, and policy-safe test prompts.
humanGates: Create or update the GPT in the ChatGPT builder.
Test actions, privacy policy, conversation starters, and store review.
limitations: Custom GPT configuration is a distinct host artifact, not an Agent Plugin projection.

headlessValidation: Run the Claude plugin validator and manifest checks.
Exercise clean plugin install, discovery, activation, update, and removal in the exact Claude Code build under test.
humanGates: Approve hooks, local commands, credentials, and any marketplace source before distribution.
limitations: Claude Code plugin evidence proves neither Claude connector review nor MCP Apps rendering.

headlessValidation: Validate remote MCP transport, tool schemas, annotations, authentication failures, and redacted tool results.
humanGates: Connect an authorized Claude staging account, approve OAuth scopes, and exercise discovery, tool execution, disconnect, and removal.
Complete connector review, privacy review, listing assets, and retain the exact review outcome.
limitations: A connector receipt does not prove Claude Code plugin installation or MCP Apps user-interface behavior.
MCPB is only appropriate for explicitly local desktop installation needs.

headlessValidation: Validate MCP Apps resources, security boundaries, text fallback, and deterministic render fixtures before connected-host capture.
humanGates: Render the exact app in an authorized Claude staging host and capture interaction, permission, fallback, disconnect, and cleanup evidence.
Review custom UI, content security policy, external domains, accessibility, privacy, and any required screenshots.
limitations: MCP Apps runtime evidence does not prove connector directory review or Claude Code plugin behavior.

headlessValidation: Validate Agent Plugin package shape and MCP configuration.
Run clean install, skill discovery, tool call, update, and uninstall in a disposable profile.
humanGates: Review requested permissions and marketplace presentation.
Approve final listing submission and screenshots.
limitations: Host verification must identify Cursor version, channel, OS, and plan.

surfaces.surface: VS Code and GitHub Copilot agent plugins
headlessValidation: Validate Agent Plugin package and VS Code extension compatibility.
Test discovery and execution in a clean VS Code profile.
humanGates: Test with authorized GitHub Copilot plans.
Review VS Code Marketplace assets and publish permissions.
limitations: VS Code and hosted GitHub surfaces require separate receipts when behavior differs.

headlessValidation: Validate native plugin.json, mcp_config.json, skills, rules, and hooks boundaries.
Test bundled/manual install, discovery, execution, update, and removal in a disposable Antigravity profile.
humanGates: Confirm Antigravity availability and an eligible Google staging account.
Review hooks and MCP permissions, capture in-host behavior, and approve any Build with Google submission path.
limitations: Antigravity uses a native plugin.json plus mcp_config.json layout; do not label the portable Agent Plugin core host-verified without a documented compatibility path.

headlessValidation: Validate gemini-extension.json and MCP settings.
Run install, command discovery, tool execution, update, and uninstall.
humanGates: Confirm OAuth consent and any extension catalog listing.
limitations: Do not position Gemini CLI compatibility as the primary Google marketplace lane.

headlessValidation: Validate remote MCP transport, schema, authentication errors, and tool results.
humanGates: Use an eligible personal Google staging account with Spark access and Keep Activity enabled.
Review Dynamic Client Registration, credentials, write confirmations, privacy policy, and disconnect/remove behavior.
limitations: Custom MCP apps are currently limited by Google eligibility, account, age, region, language, and Spark-access requirements.
This is a direct connected-app lane, not a public Agent Plugin marketplace claim.

headlessValidation: Lint deployment descriptors, OAuth scopes, privacy links, and test fixtures.
Run Apps Script or HTTP endpoint integration tests.
humanGates: Configure Cloud project, consent screen, test users, domain policies, and Marketplace review.
limitations: Workspace add-ons are commercial host-native products, not Agent Plugin projections.

headlessValidation: Validate A2A agent card, authentication, task lifecycle, and trace correlation.
Run conformance and negative permission tests in a staging project.
humanGates: Provision Google Cloud project, IAM, service identity, billing, and enterprise catalog access.
limitations: Enterprise publication and support are tenant-scoped and need customer-specific receipts.

headlessValidation: Validate Grok/Claude-compatible plugin layout and MCP settings.
Run local-dir or marketplace-source install, skill discovery, MCP tool execution, update, and removal.
humanGates: Confirm Grok Build access, configure secrets, trust any hooks, and record in-host behavior.
Approve any public marketplace source before distribution.
limitations: Grok documents Claude Code compatibility and configured marketplace sources; public publication workflow still needs a surface-specific receipt.

headlessValidation: Lint exported skill instructions and MCP metadata.
Test task invocation, permissions, failure handling, and removal in a staging workspace.

headlessValidation: Run portable plugin validation and Hermes install/discovery tests.
Exercise MCP tool calls and safety failure cases.
humanGates: Review environment permissions and any community directory submission.
limitations: Support claims are limited to tested Hermes releases and operating systems.

humanGates: Approve npm provenance and any community listing.
